// Synthetic gorilla/mux routes fixture. .txt extension keeps the file
// out of `go build`; the extractor parses via tree-sitter regardless of
// extension.

package routes

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/gorilla/mux"
)

// RegisterRoutes wires the application's gorilla/mux routes.
func RegisterRoutes(r *mux.Router) {
	r.HandleFunc("/v1/orders/{id}", GetOrder).Methods("GET")
	r.HandleFunc("/v1/orders", CreateOrder).Methods("POST")
	r.Handle("/v1/health", healthHandler).Methods("GET", "HEAD")
	r.HandleFunc("/v1/anonymous", func(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte("inline"))
	}).Methods("GET")
	r.HandleFunc("/v1/match-all", AnyHandler)

	sub := r.PathPrefix("/api").Subrouter()
	sub.HandleFunc("/orders", ListOrders).Methods("GET")
}

func GetOrder(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request)    {}
func CreateOrder(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {}
func AnyHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request)  {}
func ListOrders(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request)  {}

var healthHandler http.HandlerFunc
